This '''hospital''' was located in the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]].

==History==
[[File:SundariHospitalLogo-Corruption.svg|thumb|left|100px|The hospital's insignia]]
The hospital was a tall building with two adjacent buildings connected to the main tower. The facility had a landing area for [[Transport/Legends|transports]] in front of the main entrance. It was newly built when [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] visited the world during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

While showing Padmé the new hospital, [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] had discovered the [[Medcenter/Legends|hospital]] received many children who had been [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]] by [[Slabin/Legends|slabin]]-spiked [[Ardees Beverage Company/Legends|Ardees Beverage Company]] [[Tea/Legends|tea]], though the source of the problem was unknown at the time. [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Zak Zaz/Legends|Zak Zaz]] worked as a physician in the hospital.
